premises.text: Brick-and-mortar dominates sales volume but shops lack online personalization and recommendations
premises.evidence_span: When we go online, you feel like all these websites know you. Whatever you search will show up in your email titles. You get product recommendations. You get different product reviews. You don't get any of that rich data when you walk into a store

premises.text: Retailers cannot distinguish shopper intent or personality across in-store transactions
premises.evidence_span: every single customer that comes into your store wants something different. How do you know if they're in there to be after the newest products or the sales?

premises.text: POS-triggered personalization attaches recommended products and rich visuals to digital receipts
premises.evidence_span: we can send him a copy of the receipt, and alongside it, put in all those rich visuals with the recommended products

premises.text: Brand dashboard turns spreadsheets into visual growth drivers, customer lists, and purchase histories
premises.evidence_span: These are the growth drivers. You can see that in the middle, 80% of your customers in the middle are actually growing

premises.text: Go-to-market focuses on mid-to-high luxury standalone fashion brands
premises.evidence_span: We went after the individual brands in the mid to high luxury tier fashion retailer

value.text: Customize brick-and-mortar retail for every shopper
value.evidence_span: make it customized for everyone here
